questions.question: It was not until I had finished my studies that I realized the true value of a liberal arts education.
options: I hadn't realized it until after finishing my studies.
Only when I'd completed my studies did I realize its worth.
It wasn't until I'd finished studying that I understood its value.
The value only became clear to me once I had graduated.
questions.answer: It wasn't until I'd finished studying that I understood its value.

questions.question: Although she was an excellent teacher, her classes were often marred by the students' lack of interest.
options: Despite being an excellent teacher, her classes were frequently disrupted.
It was unfortunate that her teaching skills were undermined by the students' apathy.
Her exceptional teaching abilities were overshadowed by the students' disinterest.
Although she was a good teacher, it's true that her classes were often unengaging.
questions.answer: Despite being an excellent teacher, her classes were frequently disrupted.

questions.question: By the time I had arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
options: When I got to the party, nearly everyone was still there.
Most people stayed until I arrived; it was quite late by then.
The majority of the guests had departed before my arrival.
I found that many guests had gone home just as I was arriving.
questions.answer: The majority of the guests had departed before my arrival.

questions.question: Unless you can provide a valid reason for your absence, I'm afraid you'll have to accept full responsibility.
options: In case you're unable to attend, please give me a good excuse.
If there's a legitimate explanation for your absence, I'd be happy to discuss it with you.
You should only be held accountable if you can't offer a valid reason for missing the meeting.
Please provide a satisfactory explanation for your absence; otherwise, you'll have to accept full responsibility.
questions.answer: You should only be held accountable if you can't offer a valid reason for missing the meeting.

questions.question: It is essential that we establish clear communication channels in order to avoid misunderstandings.
options: We must make sure our lines of communication are open and transparent.
Effective communication is crucial; let's ensure we're on the same page.
To prevent any confusion, it's vital we have a common language.
Clear communication is essential for avoiding miscommunication.
questions.answer: Clear communication is essential for avoiding miscommunication.
